analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date and adds one row to the scheduler configuration table (head line 1387), `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`. The row says that for dense Qwen3.5/3.8 with the paged complete store, a prefill range ends just below the prompt end when doing so saves at least a token floor. The base-side text I reviewed (inference.md lines 806-1611) is unchanged context and contains no new behavior. The patch excerpt is truncated, and the source code behind the new row (EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift) was not supplied. I therefore cannot verify the implementation.

Relevant threat: T-041, the prefix-cache TTFT oracle and at-rest artifacts. The new end-of-prompt checkpoint boundary would create more complete SSD checkpoints for dense Qwen donations. The cache's per-donation gate, HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, salt scoping and DBK3 AAD are not described as changed here. Because no code is in scope, I found no evidence of a regression in the at-rest metadata, TTL or lookup-key derivation. Integration should confirm that the real change keeps the adoption/benefit floor, salt-scoped HMAC tags and TTL unchanged. It should also confirm that the earlier checkpoint capture adds no prompt-derived plaintext metadata. No other threat-model assets, trust boundaries or mitigations are touched by this documentation-only change.
